networks.name: support_desk
networks.description: Ask about our plain-language support pages for living with asthma. To chat, add your own AI provider key in AI model settings above this chat. A demonstration site; no medical advice.
sample_queries: How can I get ready for an appointment about my asthma?
I look after my son, who has asthma. Where can I find support?
Are there clinical studies recruiting for asthma?
Which inhaler is best for me?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the partner sites in allowed_peers, each after the visitor agrees on a card.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
